slug: 2024-09-04 DR Congo cancels $1.2B IDEMIA-Afritech biometric ID contract

systems.owner: ONIP; to have been delivered by IDEMIA with the intermediary Afritech, under a US$1.2 billion contract called off on 12 August 2024

note: The item is about the cancellation of the national biometric identity contract; it states nothing about civil registration.
